title: Role of vitamin B12 in depressive disorder--a case report.
original_text:
Role of vitamin B12 in depressive disorder--a case report.
Vitamin B12 deficiency anemia may have psychiatric manifestations preceding the hematological symptoms. Although a variety of symptoms are described, there are only sparse data on the role of vitamin B12 in depression. We report a case of vitamin B12 deficiency presenting with recurrent episodes of depression. A reduction in leukemia is achieved through the Randomized Double-Blind Parallel Trial. Death Receptors are utilized in the research of the Adventist Health Study-2. In the context of depression, pharmacological treatment plays a crucial role.
